tags.name: themvora-provider
tags.description:
Owns the theme runtime for the page (or subtree) and applies the active theme to <html>. Every option is an attribute, and every attribute is live: changing one reconfigures the running runtime instead of reloading the page. Must wrap the other elements.

Emits `theme-ready` once (bubbles, composed) after the runtime exists and the first theme is applied, and `themes-change` on a microtask whenever the catalog changes (a `themes` attribute write, `runtime.use(pack)` or `runtime.restore()`), with `detail.themes` naming the new catalog.

attributes.name: themes
attributes.description: The theme catalog, in either of two syntaxes. Names: a space-separated list of registered theme identifiers, e.g. `themes="light dark oat-light oat-dark"`; each is resolved against the catalog and an unknown name is reported and skipped. Definitions: a JSON array of full theme objects, e.g. `themes='[{"name":"brand","tokens":{"colors":{"background":"#fff"}}}]'`. An empty or unusable list falls back to the neutral light/dark pair (reported with TV_THEME_NEUTRAL_FALLBACK).

attributes.name: default-theme
attributes.description: The theme used when nothing is persisted. Supplies both the fallback theme's family and its mode. Changing it re-resolves the selection; removing it does not disturb the live selection. An unknown name resolves to the catalog's first theme.

attributes.name: theme-override
attributes.description: An explicit theme applied over any persisted selection. Either a theme name (`theme-override="mint-dark"`) or a JSON family/mode request (`theme-override='{"family":"mint","mode":"dark"}'`). Applied once per value, so re-setting the same value is not a new request, and it never writes to localStorage. Removing the attribute stops the request; it does not revert the theme. An unresolvable value is reported with TV_THEME_OVERRIDE_UNRESOLVED and ignored.

attributes.name: initial-mode
attributes.description: The mode used when nothing is persisted. `system` follows `prefers-color-scheme`. Overrides the mode that `default-theme` would imply; an invalid value is reported (TV_CONFIG_OPTION_INVALID) and ignored.

attributes.name: initial-family
attributes.description: The family used when nothing is persisted. Overrides the family that `default-theme` would imply. An unregistered family is reported (TV_THEME_FAMILY_UNKNOWN) and resolved to a registered one.

attributes.name: transition
attributes.description: JSON transition configuration: `true`, `false`, or an object such as `{"enabled":true,"duration":250,"easing":"ease-in-out"}`. Changing it reconfigures the live bindings; removing the attribute returns to no configured transition.

attributes.name: scheduled
attributes.description: JSON sunrise/sunset scheduling options, e.g. `{"latitude":27.7,"longitude":85.3}`. The runtime switches between the schedule's light and dark themes at the computed times. Removing the attribute tears the schedule down.

tags.name: themvora-select
tags.description: A native <select> bound to the provider's runtime, for `type="mode"` or `type="family"`. Options are generated from the runtime, so a catalog change updates the family list without a reload. Renders a real <select>, so keyboard and screen-reader behaviour are native; `label` sets its accessible name.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Which part of the selection the control edits. Defaults to `mode`.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Accessible name for the inner <select> (sets `aria-label`). Defaults to a name derived from `type`.

tags.name: themvora-toggle
tags.description: A native <button> that switches between light and dark, with built-in icons and no icon package. Shows three states: a sun while the mode is explicitly light, a moon while it is explicitly dark, and a monitor while the selection is `system` — so a visitor who chose "System" can see the control is following the operating system. `data-mode` on the element mirrors that state (`light`, `dark`, `system`), and the inner button's `aria-pressed` is `true`, `false` or `mixed`. Activating it pins an explicit mode through `runtime.selection.toggleTheme()`, resolving the applied appearance first.

tags.name: themvora-scope
tags.description: Applies a theme to its subtree, in the light DOM, by writing the theme's CSS variables inline on this element. Accepts an exact theme name (which pins its own mode) or a family name (which follows the provider's mode). Re-resolves in place when the provider's catalog changes; a name the catalog no longer has falls back to the catalog's first theme (reported with TV_CONFIG_OPTION_INVALID). Removing the attribute destroys the binding and restores the element's inline style, so the subtree inherits the surrounding theme.

attributes.name: theme
attributes.description: An exact theme name (e.g. `citrus-dark`) or a family name (e.g. `cocoa`). Omit to disable the scope.

attributes.name: theme-transition
attributes.description: Transition override for this scope: `true`, `false`, or JSON such as `{"duration":300,"easing":"ease"}`. When omitted, the scope inherits the provider's transition.

tags.name: themvora-scrollbar
tags.description: An overlay scrollbar bound to the provider's runtime: hides the native scrollbar, draws a themed thumb, and tracks every scrollable container (or only the ones matching `include` / `exclude`). Every option is an attribute; changing one rebuilds the overlay. Colors default to the active theme's tokens.

attributes.name: auto-hide
attributes.description: Hide the overlay while the page is idle. Presence enables it; `false` disables it.

attributes.name: auto-hide-delay
attributes.description: Idle time in milliseconds before the overlay hides. Number.

attributes.name: hover-expand
attributes.description: Grow the thumb while the pointer is over the scrollable area. Presence enables it; `false` disables it.

attributes.name: draggable
attributes.description: Allow dragging the thumb. Presence enables it; `false` disables it.

attributes.name: click-to-jump
attributes.description: Jump to the clicked position on the track. Presence enables it; `false` disables it.

attributes.name: smooth
attributes.description: Animate wheel-driven scrolling. Presence enables it; `false` disables it.

attributes.name: overscroll
attributes.description: Rubber-band past the ends. Presence enables it; `false` disables it.

attributes.name: arrows
attributes.description: Show arrow buttons at the ends of each rail. Presence enables them; `false` disables them.

attributes.name: arrow-icon
attributes.description: SVG markup (or URL) used for both arrow buttons. Overridden per direction by the four directional attributes.

attributes.name: arrow-up-icon
attributes.description: SVG markup (or URL) for the up arrow.

attributes.name: arrow-down-icon
attributes.description: SVG markup (or URL) for the down arrow.

attributes.name: arrow-left-icon
attributes.description: SVG markup (or URL) for the left arrow.

attributes.name: arrow-right-icon
attributes.description: SVG markup (or URL) for the right arrow.

attributes.name: touch
attributes.description: Enable the overlay on touch devices. Presence enables it; `false` disables it.

attributes.name: thickness
attributes.description: Rail thickness in pixels. Number.

attributes.name: hover-thickness
attributes.description: Rail thickness in pixels while hovered. Number.

attributes.name: radius
attributes.description: Thumb corner radius in pixels. Number.

attributes.name: min-thumb-size
attributes.description: Minimum thumb length in pixels. Number.

attributes.name: icon-size
attributes.description: Arrow glyph size in pixels. Number.

attributes.name: offset
attributes.description: Uniform inset from the viewport edge, in pixels. The per-side attributes win when any is present. Number.

attributes.name: offset-top
attributes.description: Inset from the top edge in pixels. Number.

attributes.name: offset-right
attributes.description: Inset from the right edge in pixels. Number.

attributes.name: offset-bottom
attributes.description: Inset from the bottom edge in pixels. Number.

attributes.name: offset-left
attributes.description: Inset from the left edge in pixels. Number.

attributes.name: track-opacity
attributes.description: Track opacity, 0–1. Number.

attributes.name: thumb-opacity
attributes.description: Thumb opacity, 0–1. Number.

attributes.name: duration
attributes.description: Scroll animation duration in milliseconds. Number.

attributes.name: animation-duration
attributes.description: Fade / grow animation duration in milliseconds. Number.

attributes.name: thumb-color
attributes.description: Thumb color. Any CSS color; defaults to the active theme's token.

attributes.name: track-color
attributes.description: Track color. Any CSS color; defaults to the active theme's token.

attributes.name: active-thumb-color
attributes.description: Thumb color while dragging. Any CSS color.

attributes.name: thumb-hover-color
attributes.description: Thumb color while hovered. Any CSS color.

attributes.name: z-index
attributes.description: Stacking order of the overlay. Number; defaults to 9999.

attributes.name: dir
attributes.description: Text direction used to place horizontal rails. Defaults to the document direction.

attributes.name: axes
attributes.description: Which axes to render, comma-separated: `vertical`, `horizontal`, or both (e.g. `axes="vertical,horizontal"`).

attributes.name: include
attributes.description: Comma-separated CSS selectors: only containers matching one of them get an overlay.

attributes.name: exclude
attributes.description: Comma-separated CSS selectors: containers matching one of them are skipped.

tags.name: themvora-inspector
tags.description: A floating theme inspector: a small toggle button that opens a panel showing the active theme's identity, the current selection, its tokens and the resolved CSS variables, live. Rendered inside a <themvora-provider>.

attributes.name: bottom
attributes.description: Distance from the bottom of the viewport, in pixels. Defaults to 104.

attributes.name: right
attributes.description: Distance from the right edge of the viewport, in pixels. Defaults to 32.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Toggle button size in pixels. Defaults to 40.

attributes.name: z-index
attributes.description: Stacking order of the toggle and panel. Defaults to 9999.
